cohort: 17,693 infants born between 24 and 42 weeks of gestation at the Health Sciences University Istanbul Training and Research Hospital.
finding: The study established current regional anthropometric measurement percentiles for newborns, which significantly differed from existing national and international growth charts, potentially impacting the accurate diagnosis and follow-up of SGA and LGA infants.
cross-section timing: Data collected from birth records between January 2018 and December 2023.
